Container.Name: Tagwerk
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music library manager: library dashboard, tag editing (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, M4A), MusicBrainz lookup and Navidrome integration. Changes are reviewed before they are written to your files.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Your music share, e.g. /mnt/user/music. Use the same folder your Navidrome container uses. Read-write so tags can be edited.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database and settings. Keep appdata on a pool (exclusive share) so SQLite works reliably.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for newly created files.
